_comment: Maps a Cloudflare named tunnel to the public URL its hostname serves. Shared source of truth for main.py (startup banner), control_server.py (/api/tunnels) and the control panel (phone links). Add an entry here whenever you create a tunnel with `cloudflared tunnel route dns <tunnel> <hostname>`. Order matters: the control panel selects the FIRST entry by default, so keep the live tunnel at the top.
